Many hours, spread over several days (14 main missions + 6 extra)

Join the {wiki:Tibian Explorer Society|Explorer Society} in Port Hope or Northport and rise in rank (Novice, Journeyman, Relic Hunter, Explorer) by doing missions all over Tibia: ancient ice from Folda, butterflies, plants from Tiquanda, the lizards' urn, orc dust, an elven book, the Memory Stone, the Queen of the Banshees' dress and much more. At the end you gain access to the astral bridges (Port Hope ↔ Northport and Liberty Bay ↔ Svargrond), to {wiki:Calassa} and the Frozen Trench, 6 {item:Orichalcum Pearl|Orichalcum Pearls}, a {item:Crown Backpack} and three achievements.
The Explorer Society is a noble order of explorers who ventured into the heart of the kingdom of Tibia. You can join it and rise in rank by helping them with their expeditions.
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 110+** (some missions can be done from level 8–25; the hardest ones — Undersea Kingdom and Island of Dragons — ask for 110).
For the extra mission **The Undersea Kingdom** you need the **Relic Hunter** rank.
For **The Island of Dragons** and **The Frozen Trench** you need the {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest} done up to the final mission; the Frozen Trench also requires The Undersea Kingdom to be completed.
For **The Spectral Dress** it is much easier to have done the {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest} (access to the catacombs of the Isle of the Kings).
{spell:Levitate} spell (Frozen Trench; optional in Orc Powder).
or the Magic Rope spell; you need it in several missions
Spectral Dress, Island of Dragons and Undersea Kingdom
only if you go fetch the Family Brooch from Dwacatra
in case the Hellgate door is closed (Elven Poetry)
for diving (Calassa and Frozen Trench); rented from Captain Max for a 5000 gp deposit, weighs 210 oz
optional, helps a lot against minotaurs, orcs and butterflies
At least **100 oz** of free capacity for the {item:Funeral Urn}
200 gp for the trip to Calassa and money for {npc:Buddel}'s trips
5250 gp in total (5000 for the Island of Dragons + 250 for the Skull of Ratha)
Ability to buy {item:Atlas|Atlases} (from Relic Hunter), {item:Orichalcum Pearl|Orichalcum Pearls} and {item:Crown Backpack|Crown Backpacks} from the representatives
Access to the astral bridges Port Hope ↔ Northport and Liberty Bay ↔ Svargrond (1 {item:Orichalcum Pearl} per trip)
Access to {wiki:Calassa} and the {wiki:Frozen Trench} (underwater hunting)
**Explorer**, **Sea Scout** and **Just in Time** achievements (the last one if you meet the extra requirement)
When you reach the **Novice** rank (end of Joining the Explorers): {npc:Captain Max}, in Liberty Bay, will take you to Yalahar.
This is the usual requirement for the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}; alternatively there is the password from {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice} (boat from Thais).
When you reach the **Relic Hunter** rank: you can buy them at the Explorer Society headquarters.
In the extra mission **The Undersea Kingdom**: {npc:Berenice} tells {npc:Captain Max} to take you there and, after you hand in the logbook, you get access.
To accept the mission you need the **Relic Hunter** rank.
After The Undersea Kingdom, in the extra mission **The Frozen Trench** (with {npc:Lurik}, in Svargrond).
Also requires progress in {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest}; you need a {item:Helmet of the Deep} and {spell:Levitate}.
In the last mission, **The Astral Portals** (Explorer rank).
Uses 1 {item:Orichalcum Pearl} per trip; Premium only.
When you report the extra mission **The Ice Music** to {npc:Lurik}.
Uses 1 {item:Orichalcum Pearl} per trip; Premium only.
After **The Astral Portals**: you can buy them from the Explorer Society representatives.
There are two main headquarters: {npc:Angus} in **Port Hope** and {npc:Mortimer} in **Northport**. You can ask for and hand in missions at either one (the dialogues are the same).

Ask for the list of available missions with {key:mission}. Within each rank (Novice, Journeyman, Relic Hunter) you can do the missions in **any order**; in the Explorer rank they have to be done one by one, in the order of this guide.

Combine missions: the Butterfly Hunt and the Plant Collection can be done at the same time in Tiquanda; the Bonelord Secret can be combined with the {wiki:Stealth Ring Quest}; the Spectral Dress with the {wiki:The Queen of the Banshees Quest}.
A {item:Stealth Ring} or the {spell:Invisibility|Invisibility} spell saves you a lot of trouble with minotaurs, orcs (except Orc Leaders and Orc Warlords) and butterflies that run away.
The extra missions from {npc:Lurik} (Svargrond), {npc:Berenice} (Liberty Bay) and the Skull of Ratha / Giant Smith Hammer are not needed to rank up, but give rewards and access.

You start with no rank. Each rank has its own missions; when you finish all those of your rank, you rank up automatically. Use this table to plan (recommended level to do the mission solo, with the full spawn).
Extra (Ice Islands up to the final mission)
Extra (Undersea Kingdom + Ice Islands up to the final mission)
1. Joining the Explorers — joining the society
To join you must bring the society a {item:Dwarven Pickaxe}, ordered from {npc:Uzgod} in Kazordoon.

Go to the Explorer Society headquarters in **Port Hope** or **Northport**. Talk to {npc:Angus} (Port Hope) or {npc:Mortimer} (Northport): {key:hi}, {key:join}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} again. They ask you for the pickaxe ordered from Uzgod.
Quick option: get a pickaxe without Uzgod

You do not need to talk to Uzgod if you have a {item:Dwarven Pickaxe} by other means: it appears as a **daily respawn** in several {wiki:Dwarf Mines} (see the {item:Dwarven Pickaxe} page for the locations) or you can buy it on the **Market**. If you have it, skip to the step "Handing in the pickaxe".

In **Kazordoon**, talk to {npc:Uzgod}: {key:hi}, {key:pickaxe}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. He only gives you the pickaxe in exchange for his {item:Family Brooch (Dwarven)|Family Brooch}, which a thief took to the Dwacatra prison. You have to talk to him **before** you can pick up the brooch.

{wiki:Dwacatra} is near the **main gate of Kazordoon**. You need a {item:Shovel}, {item:Rope} (or Magic Rope) and the {item:Key 3802} (the prison key; according to Uzgod it is in the general's room, next to the arsenal — see the {item:Key 3802} page to get it). Dwacatra is the prison deep beneath Kazordoon: it has small holes that open with the {item:Shovel} and open holes with creatures, so do not go without a shovel or rope.
Dwacatra entrance, near the main gate of Kazordoon

In the prison look for the **hole in the centre** and go down. Down there are 3 {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers} and 1 {creature:Dwarf Guard}: kill them. The {item:Family Brooch (Dwarven)|Family Brooch} is behind the **sealed door to the south**.
Hole in the centre of the Dwacatra prison
The hole in the centre of the prison

With the brooch, go back the same way: climb up with the {item:Rope} (or Magic Rope) through the hole in the centre of the prison and the other holes you went down, until you are back in Kazordoon, where {npc:Uzgod} is.
Swapping the brooch for the pickaxe
Go back to {npc:Uzgod}: {key:hi}, {key:brooch}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. You receive the {item:Dwarven Pickaxe} (60 oz).
Take the pickaxe to {npc:Angus} or {npc:Mortimer}: {key:hi}, {key:pickaxe}, {key:yes}. You become an official member with the **Novice** rank and can ask for a {key:mission}.
You have to bring ancient ice from the Folda caves **before it melts (10 minutes)**. Accept this mission from {npc:Mortimer}, in **Northport**, which is much closer to Folda.
Say {key:hi}, {key:ice delivery} and {key:yes}. You get an {item:Ice Pick} (70 oz).

{wiki:Folda} is the largest of the three ice islands, northwest of Carlin. Go to the ferryman {npc:Nielson}, northwest of Carlin, and ask him for passage to {key:Folda} (20 gp): {key:hi}, {key:Folda}, {key:yes}. You disembark at the Folda docks, where the ferryman {npc:Svenson} is.
Getting to the icy room in Folda

Go to {wiki:Folda} and enter the main cave (the main entrance is inside the mountain; you can also enter through the hole in the ice south of the mountain). Follow the maps to a small icy room on the **second underground floor**, with {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} and {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers}. Kill everything on the way: on the way back you cannot waste time.
Use the {item:Ice Pick} on the icy stalagmites to receive an {item:Icicle (Item)|Icicle}. From here you have **10 minutes** before it melts: run back to the representative who gave you the mission.
If the icicle melts you do not lose the mission: go to the representative, say {key:ice delivery}, {key:no} and {key:yes} and he gives you another chance.

Go up the same way you came down to the surface and go to the docks. Say {key:hi}, {key:Tibia}, {key:yes} to {npc:Svenson}: the trip back to the mainland is free. On the mainland, run to **Northport** (northeast of Carlin), where {npc:Mortimer} is.
Do not waste time on the way: the icicle's 10-minute clock keeps counting during the trip.
**Just in Time** achievement — only if you have already done the Wednesday mission of the {wiki:The Travelling Trader Quest}
You have to hand in three butterflies, one at a time and in this order: **purple, blue and red**. Tip: also accept the Plant Collection and do both at the same time in Tiquanda.
Talk to {npc:Angus} (or Mortimer): {key:hi}, {key:butterfly hunt}, {key:yes}. You receive a {item:Butterfly Conservation Kit (Empty)}.
If you lose the kit, buy another from the representatives by saying {key:preparation kit}.

The three butterflies appear more or less in the area of the map below (Tiquanda). Alternatively: the {creature:Butterfly (Purple)|purple} and the {creature:Butterfly (Blue)|blue} appear next to the {wiki:Grumpy Stone} north of Kazordoon; the blue and the {creature:Butterfly (Red)|red} next to the {wiki:Tired Tree} north of Carlin.
Area where the red, blue and purple butterflies appear

If the butterfly runs away, use a {item:Stealth Ring} or {spell:Invisibility|Invisibility}: it stays still. If you find one you do not need yet, you can trap it or kill it and take the body — but it has to be a **fresh** body.

Kill a {creature:Butterfly (Purple)|Purple Butterfly} and use the kit on the **fresh** body to get the {item:Butterfly Conservation Kit (Purple)}. Go back to the representative: {key:butterfly hunt}, {key:yes} and then {key:butterfly hunt} again to receive the next kit.

Kill a {creature:Butterfly (Blue)|Blue Butterfly}, use the kit on the body and you receive the {item:Butterfly Conservation Kit (Blue)}. Go back: {key:butterfly hunt}, {key:yes}, {key:butterfly hunt}.

Kill a {creature:Butterfly (Red)|Red Butterfly}, use the kit on the body and you receive the {item:Butterfly Conservation Kit (Red)}. Go back and say {key:butterfly hunt}, {key:yes}. Mission complete.
Collect samples of three Tiquanda plants, one at a time and in this order, returning to the representative after each one.
Talk to {npc:Angus}: {key:hi}, {key:plant collection}, {key:yes}. You receive a {item:Botanist's Container (Empty)}.
Location of the plants in Tiquanda

Use the container on a {item:Jungle Bells Plant} (there is one nearby, at the marked spot) to receive the {item:Botanist's Container (Bells)}. Go back to Angus: {key:plant collection}, {key:yes} and {key:plant collection} again for the next container.

Use the container on a {item:Witches Cauldron Plant} (the easiest is at the marked spot) and you receive the {item:Botanist's Container (Cauldron)}. Go back: {key:plant collection}, {key:yes}, {key:plant collection}.
Use the container on a {item:Giant Jungle Rose} (one of the closest is at the marked spot) and you receive the {item:Botanist's Container (Rose)}. Go back and say {key:plant collection}, {key:yes}.
With the three Novice missions handed in, you rank up to **Journeyman**
Bring the sacred {item:Funeral Urn} from the lizard village of {wiki:Chor}. Ask for the list with {key:mission}: lizard urn, bonelord secrets and orc powder (any order).
The urn is very heavy: you need **100 oz** of free capacity.

Choose a path: (1) if you have enough points in the {wiki:Paw and Fur Society}, {npc:Lorek} takes you straight to Chor for 30 gp; (2) cross the south half of **Port Hope** and cross the log bridge that leads to Chor; (3) it may be easier to come from **Ankrahmun** through the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass} or the {wiki:Darama Terramite Cave}.
Arrival of Lorek's boat in Chor
Pick up the urn in the temple

Go to the central islet with the lizards' temple and go down. Down there are many low-level {wiki:Lizards|lizards} of all kinds: clear the dungeon and pick up the {item:Funeral Urn} in the **north room**.
North room with the Funeral Urn

Go up the temple stairs and go back on foot the same way: cross the log bridge and head **west** through the south half of **Port Hope** (or go back to Ankrahmun through the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass}, if you came that way). {npc:Lorek}'s boat only makes the **one-way** trip to Chor: there is no boat back.
Go back to the representative: {key:hi}, {key:lizard urn}, {key:yes}.
Search the {wiki:Dark Pyramid}, northeast of Darashia, for proof that the bonelords built it.
You can do the {wiki:Stealth Ring Quest} at the same time: the rewards are in two coffins on the {creature:Mummy} floor.
Go to **Darashia** and walk far **northeast** to the Dark Pyramid, now full of minotaurs.

There are many minotaurs, especially on the 3rd floor. A {item:Stealth Ring} or {spell:Invisibility|Invisibility} helps against all but the {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages}; {item:Avalanche Rune|Avalanche Runes} clear the spawn well.
Go down the stairs. You meet many {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} and 2 {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards}. Go **west** and go down the western stairs.
Go down the stairs to the west
Here there are many {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers} and {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards}. Go **east** and go down the eastern stairs.
Go down the stairs to the east
Many {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers}, {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards} and {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages}. Kill them and go down the stairs to the **north**.
Go down the stairs to the north
You find a single {creature:Mummy}. You are in the {wiki:Stealth Ring Quest} room: if you want, search the coffins. Then go down again.
Search the coffins (Stealth Ring Quest, optional) and go down the stairs
You reach an empty room with a sealed door. Behind it, open the box and pick up the {item:Wrinkled Parchment}.
Receive the Wrinkled Parchment from the box

Go back the same way, floor by floor, going up the same stairs you came down (they are the ones on the maps of the previous steps), to the surface. From there return to **Darashia**, southwest of the pyramid.
Go back to the representative: {key:hi}, {key:bonelord secrets}, {key:yes}.
The hardest mission so far: climb a mountain full of orcs in {wiki:Ulderek's Rock} (Orc Fortress) to fetch a sample of {item:Strange Powder}.

Go to **Ulderek's Rock** (Orc Fortress), which is northwest of Venore, southeast of Ab'Dendriel and east of {wiki:Ferngrims Gate}. Enter the fort, go to the **north** side and follow the wall **east/northeast** to the end. Enter the mountain through the fort's walls.
Find the inside of the mountain through the fort

You will face {creature:Orc Warlord|Orc Warlords}, {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders}, {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers} and, rarely, {creature:Warlord Ruzad}. Only the Orc Leaders and Orc Warlords are not fooled by invisibility, so a {item:Stealth Ring} helps a lot.

Go up **5 floors** through the mountain; the orcs get stronger on each floor. 1st floor: 2 {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders}, 1 {creature:Orc Berserker}, 2 {creature:Orc Shaman|Orc Shamans} and ~6 {creature:War Wolf|War Wolves}. 2nd floor: 3 Orc Leaders, 3 Orc Berserkers, 3 {creature:Orc Rider|Orc Riders}, 3 Orc Shamans and 5 War Wolves.
From the 2nd floor you can go up the mountainside with {spell:Levitate}: fewer orcs appear and fewer can reach you at the same time.
On the top floor there is a sealed door. Inside, the box has the {item:Strange Powder}.
On the top floor, the box with the Strange Powder

Go down the 5 floors the same way (or by the mountainside, if you went up with {spell:Levitate}), leave the fort through the walls you came in by and get away from Ulderek's Rock before stopping to rest: the fort's orcs move in large groups.
Go back to the representative: {key:hi}, {key:orc powder}, {key:yes}.
With the three Journeyman missions handed in, you rank up to **Relic Hunter** (you can now buy {item:Atlas|Atlases} at the headquarters and accept The Undersea Kingdom)

Missions of this rank: elven poetry, memory stone and rune writings (any order). Here you fetch the book {item:Songs of the Forest} from {wiki:Hellgate}. Bring a {item:Rope}, {spell:Levitate} or 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels} (to climb 2 floors on the way out) and, just in case, the {item:Key 3012}. Entering Hellgate is **one-way**: to get out you have to follow the full exit route, described step by step at the end of this mission.

In **Ab'Dendriel**, go down to the floor below (the shop area), go down again next to the little houses and go down once more. Follow the path **south** and then **east** to a door with a sign saying *Hellgate*. If it is closed, open it with the {item:Key 3012}; if you do not have it, the guard {npc:Elathriel}, nearby, sells it to you for 5000 gp. Just **north** there is a second door that also needs the {item:Key 3012}.
Go through the north door and enter the portal to {wiki:Hellgate}. Do not use the portal on the **west** side of the room: that one takes you out.
The portal is one-way only. Before you enter, make sure you have a {item:Rope} and {spell:Levitate} (or 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels}): without them you cannot leave Hellgate.

You arrive at a platform with stairs. Go up the stairs and keep walking **west**. Go down the hole and go **east**, crossing the bridge. Go down the next hole and cross the bridge; go round the bend and head **east** (not north, which is the normal way out of Hellgate).
Hellgate route 1: go up the stairs and head west to the hole
Hellgate route 2: head east to the next hole
Go down the hole: here there are {creature:Elf|Elves} and {creature:Elf Scout|Elf Scouts}. Find the sealed door and pick up the {item:Elven Poetry Book} (the copy of {item:Songs of the Forest}).
Leaving Hellgate 1: going back to the exit route

With the book, climb up with the {item:Rope} through the hole you went down to the elves and go back **west** to the bend where you turned east. From here on you follow the normal exit route ({wiki:Route:Hellgate|Route:Hellgate}): at the bend go **north** and follow the long corridor (only {creature:Spider|Spiders} and {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}) to the yellow circle on the map, where you climb up with the {item:Rope}.
Exit route 3: follow the corridor to the yellow circle and climb up with the rope
Do not stray: in another hole on this floor there is a {creature:Giant Spider}.

Go **southeast** (there are some {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}). Go down the hole, walk a little **south** (2 {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}) and go up. Follow the path **south** (more Ghouls and Rotworms) and go up again. Then go **south** and go down the **first** hole you see (the second rope spot has {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and 1 Ghoul).
Exit route 4 and 5: Rotworm cave and the first hole to the south
Leaving Hellgate 3: the big Ghoul room

Go **west**. On the way you meet about 15 {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, about 5 {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and 2 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} (not all at the same time). Cross the big room keeping close to the **south** wall, to attract fewer monsters, and go down the hole.
In the big room there are also {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords}, and someone may have pulled them close to your path.
Go **northwest** (there are no monsters here). Go up **2 floors** with {spell:Levitate} or by stacking 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels}, and then go up the stairs.
Exit route 7: go up 2 floors with Levitate or Parcels and then the stairs
Leaving Hellgate 5: the hole to the southwest
Go **southwest** and climb up through the hole. Do not take the other hole, to the **southeast**: that one takes you down, to the lava floor.
Exit route 8: go up through the hole to the southwest

Here you may have to pull a lever: it lowers the bridge you have to cross one floor up (it may already be open). From here there are many {creature:Wasp|Wasps}, but there is only one way up: follow it until you come out on the surface, near Ab'Dendriel.
Exit route 9: the bridge lever and the way to the surface
There is an alternative route out of Hellgate, through {wiki:Draconia} and the {wiki:Redbone Castle}, but it is far more dangerous.
Talk to the representative: {key:hi}, {key:elven poetry}, {key:yes}. From the Hellgate exit, the nearest representative is {npc:Mortimer}, in **Northport**, northwest of Ab'Dendriel.
If you lose the book **after** taking it from the chest, buy another from {npc:Elvith} in Ab'Dendriel by saying {key:elven poetry book}.
Fetch a {item:Memory Stone} from the ruins in the northwest of Edron (Hero Cave). Bring a {item:Rope} to get out of the cave.
You cannot skip this mission by buying the stone from {npc:Black Bert}: NPCs only accept a Memory Stone if you have obtained it yourself. (If you lose it afterwards, then you can buy it to continue.)

Go to the {wiki:Hero Cave} in **Edron**. Beware of the {creature:Hunter|Hunters} at the entrance. Go down the hole and walk **north**. To get there, take a boat to **Edron** (say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} to the port captain, for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and leave the city to the **north**: the entrance is in the valley north of Edron.

Go down and follow the cave to the next hole. Here there are {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}, a {creature:Priestess}, a {creature:Dark Magician}, a {creature:Hunter} and a {creature:Bonelord}.

Go down, go **east** and follow the cave **south** until you find one set of stairs going up and another going down. On the way: {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monk}, {creature:Dark Apprentice|Dark Apprentices}, {creature:Dark Magician|Dark Magicians}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Priestess|Priestesses} and {creature:Slime|Slimes}.

Near the stairs, **do not** go down the wrong hole (there are {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}) and **do not** go down the stairs at the end of the cave (there are {creature:Grim Reaper|Grim Reapers}).
Do NOT go down this hole (Giant Spiders)
Do NOT go down these stairs (Grim Reapers)
Go down and pick up the {item:Memory Stone} in the **east room**.
The room with the Memory Stone

With the stone, go back the same way: go up the stairs and the holes you came down (use the {item:Rope} at the holes), following the maps of the previous steps in reverse, until you come out on the surface north of Edron. From there return to the city and take the boat back.
The {creature:Hunter|Hunters} at the entrance are also waiting for you on the way out.
Go back to the representative: {key:hi}, {key:memory stone}, {key:yes}.
Copy the runes from a strange structure in the dungeons of {wiki:Banuta}. You will find many {wiki:Apes|apes}; {item:Avalanche Rune|Avalanche Runes} come in handy for mages.
Talk to {npc:Angus}: {key:hi}, {key:rune writings}, {key:yes}. You receive a sheet of tracing paper ({item:Sheet of Tracing Paper|Tracing Paper}).
With enough points in the {wiki:Paw and Fur Society}, {npc:Lorek} takes you quickly to Banuta.

Go to **Banuta**, northeast of Port Hope. On the **south** side of the city there are stairs that go down to the dungeon. From **Port Hope** cross the Tiquanda jungle **northeast** to Banuta ({coord:32807,32542,7}); if you have the Ranger rank in the {wiki:Paw and Fur Society}, {npc:Lorek}, at the far **east** of Port Hope, takes you there for 30 gp.
Stairs to the dungeon (south of Banuta)
Go down and head **north**; when you reach a big room, turn **west**. You find another set of stairs.

Go down, go **west** and turn **south** at the first opportunity. Continue to a big room. In the **north** of that room is the {wiki:Atypical Structure|Atypical Structure}: use the tracing paper on it.

With the copy made, go back the same way: on floor -2 go back **north** and then **east** to the stairs and go up; on floor -1 go **east** and then **south** to the stairs and go up to the surface, on the **south** side of Banuta. From there cross the jungle **southwest** to Port Hope.
Go back to the representative: {key:hi}, {key:rune writings}, {key:yes}.
With the three Relic Hunter missions handed in, you rank up to **Explorer**
The Explorer missions have to be done **one by one and in this order**: Ectoplasm, Spectral Dress, Spectral Stone and Astral Portals. Here you just need to say {key:mission}.
Talk to {npc:Angus}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. You receive an {item:Ectoplasm Container}.

Find a spawn of {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}. {wiki:Drefia} has many, and some {wiki:Ankrahmun Tombs|Ankrahmun tombs} do too. The fastest is probably the {wiki:Ankrahmun Library Tomb}, just east of the Ankrahmun depot, behind a {item:Scarab Coin} sacrifice. Kill the Ghost and use the container on the body after the 10 seconds of protected loot. You receive the {item:Ectoplasm Container (Ectoplasm)}. In the Library Tomb, the entrance is beneath the Ankrahmun library ({coord:33142,32838,7}); to get past the teleport stand on the {wiki:Mystic Flame|Mystic Flame} and place a {item:Scarab Coin} on the {wiki:Empty Coal Basin|Empty Coal Basin} (the Ghosts are on the 3rd floor, after the teleport). With the ectoplasm, go back the same way to the library.
It has to be a **freshly killed** Ghost: ghost corpses that do not decay will not work.

Go and ask the {npc:The Queen Of The Banshees|Queen of the Banshees} for a {item:Spectral Dress}, beneath the Ghostlands. You need a {item:Pick} and a {item:Rope}. This guide assumes you have done the {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest} (access to the Isle of the Kings); if not, follow the {wiki:The Queen of the Banshees Quest} through the long way via the Ghostlands until you reach the queen.
Get to the Isle of the Kings

In **Carlin**, go to {npc:Dalbrect}'s boat, in the harbour to the **north and west** of the city (north of the {wiki:Ghostlands|Ghostlands}). Say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}: he takes you to the {wiki:Isle of the Kings} for 10 gp (only after the {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest}). On the island, the entrance to the catacombs is in the big monks' building.
Go to the {wiki:Isle of the Kings} and enter the catacombs. On the **6th floor** (start of the cave) go **north/northwest** and use the {item:Pick} on the hole hidden behind a structure.

Go down the hole and head **east/northeast** to another hole. Go down and follow the cave to a rope spot. Go up (there are 2 {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}) and head **southeast** to a stairway.
To come back this way you will have to use the pick on the hole again.

Go up the stairs (2 {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}). Go **north** and then **east** whenever you can. Keep following the cave **east**, then **north**, and follow the path to a stairway going down. Go down, clear the room and talk to the queen.
This part is dangerous: lots of {creature:Banshee|Banshees}, {creature:Mummy|Mummies}, {creature:Stalker|Stalkers} and {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}.
Say {key:hi} and {key:spectral dress}. The queen lets you take a dress that is in a box in a room to the south.
You really must talk to her **before** trying to pick up the dress.
Going down through the poison fields

Go back up the stairs and retrace your steps until you find a stairway going down. Go down and head **south**, crossing many poison fields, to another stairway going down ({creature:Ghost|Ghosts} and {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}). Go down and head **west** to a stairway going up.

Go up into a room full of {creature:Stalker|Stalkers}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}. Go down the stairway **in the middle of the room** (it may be hidden by the floor above on the map). Follow the cave **south/southeast** to a stairway going up; along the way there are lots of {creature:Banshee|Banshees}.
Stairway in the middle of the room
Go up and follow the cave **east**. In the **4th room**, behind a door on the **south** side, is the {item:Spectral Dress}. Then head back to the exit.

With the dress, retrace your steps to the start of the cave, on the 6th floor of the catacombs: to get past the pick hole again ({coord:32161,31921,13}) you have to use the {item:Pick} on it once more. Then go up through the catacombs to the monks' building and go to the boat docked on the island: say {key:hi} and {key:tibia} to {npc:Captain Jack} and he takes you back to the mainland, to the Carlin side.
Captain Jack's boat (Isle of the Kings)
Take the dress to the representative and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. You get the achievement **Explorer**.
If you lose the dress you can buy another one from {npc:Black Bert} or on the Market, but you can only hand in a bought dress if you have already picked one up yourself.

You fetch reports from the other branch and charge the two {wiki:Strange Carving|Strange Carvings} with a {item:Spectral Stone}. If you started with Angus (Port Hope), the other branch is Mortimer's (Northport), and vice versa.
Talk to your representative: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. He asks you to go to the other branch to fetch the latest reports.
Asking for the reports at the other branch
Go to the other branch and talk to the representative ({npc:Mortimer} in Northport or {npc:Angus} in Port Hope): {key:hi}, {key:mission} (ask about the {key:latest research reports}).
Go back to the representative where you started: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. You receive the {item:Spectral Stone}.

Go upstairs in this branch and use the {item:Spectral Stone} on the {wiki:Strange Carving|Strange Carving}. Then go to the other branch again, go upstairs and use the stone on the Strange Carving there.
Talk to any Explorer Society representative and report the mission ({key:hi}, {key:mission}).
The last rank mission. To complete it you need access to all the other teleports, so leave it for last.

Talk to the representative: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. You get access to the {wiki:Astral Bridge} between **Port Hope** and **Northport** (1 {item:Orichalcum Pearl} per trip, Premium only), 6 {item:Orichalcum Pearl|Orichalcum Pearls} and a {item:Crown Backpack}. From here on you can also buy Orichalcum Pearls and Crown Backpacks from the representatives.
6 {item:Orichalcum Pearl|Orichalcum Pearls}, {item:Crown Backpack} and the Port Hope ↔ Northport astral bridge

You need the **Relic Hunter** rank or higher. Bring a {item:Pick}, 200 gp for the trip and a {item:Helmet of the Deep} (you can rent it in Calassa for a 5000 gp deposit; it weighs 210 oz). Recommended level: 110.

Go to the Explorer Society branch in **Liberty Bay** and talk to {npc:Berenice}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:Calassa}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. She asks you for the {item:Damaged Logbook} from a sunken ship.
In Calassa **never** take your helmet off, or you will drown.
Look for {npc:Captain Max} on the **east** side of the Liberty Bay docks and ask him for passage to {key:Calassa} (200 gp).

Equip the {item:Helmet of the Deep} and jump overboard (leave the platform to the **south**). You land on the ocean floor and immediately face lots of small quaras ({creature:Quara Mantassin|Mantassins} and {creature:Quara Constrictor|Constrictors}).
Where you land on the seabed
Fight your way **south** and a little **east** to a medium-sized ship. Use the {item:Pick} on the wooden hatch to reveal a stairway.
Several {creature:Quara Predator|Quara Predators} patrol the lower part of the ship. Enter through the **left** side of the ship to have less chance of being seen.

Go down, kill the 2 {creature:Quara Constrictor|Quara Constrictors} and the 3 {creature:Quara Hydromancer|Quara Hydromancers}. Take the {item:Damaged Logbook} from the box behind the sealed door to the **west**.

With the logbook, go up the stairway of the sunken ship and go back the same way (**north** and a little **west**) to the area where you fell to the seabed, under {npc:Captain Max}'s boat. Return to his boat and ask him to take you back to **Liberty Bay**.

If you are going to do The Frozen Trench next, keep the {item:Helmet of the Deep} (you cannot rent it there). Otherwise, return it to {npc:Captain Max} by saying {key:return} and you get your 5000 gp deposit back.
Go back to Liberty Bay and talk to {npc:Berenice}: {key:hi}, {key:Calassa}, {key:yes}. There is no direct reward, but it unlocks The Frozen Trench (and you keep access to Calassa).

Requirements: The Undersea Kingdom completed and the {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest} done up to the final mission. Bring {spell:Levitate}, money to go to {wiki:Tyrsung} and back, and a {item:Helmet of the Deep} — you can **not** rent it here, you have to get it from {npc:Captain Max} in Calassa again. Recommended level: 80.
In **Svargrond**, talk to {npc:Lurik}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. He asks you to find out what happened to a missing explorer in the Frozen Trench.

Go to **Tyrsung** with {npc:Buddel}. There, head far **south**, pass a smugglers' camp and reach a docked boat. Go aboard and kill the 3 {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers} and the {creature:Pirate Cutthroat}. {npc:Buddel} is on the boat **south** of Svargrond: say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:tyrsung} (50 gp) and you disembark from his boat in Tyrsung.

{npc:Buddel} is always drunk and sometimes takes you to the wrong place: ask again until you arrive. With a {item:Dwarven Ring} in your backpack (and saying yes when he asks for it) he takes you to the right place for free, but you lose the ring.
Equip the {item:Helmet of the Deep} and jump into the water from the planks on the **south** side of the boat.
You will face lots of {creature:Quara Constrictor|Quara Constrictors} and {creature:Quara Mantassin|Mantassins}. Head **south** to a cliff and go down with {spell:Levitate}.

Head **west** to a cave that goes **north**. Follow it to the end, where there is a {item:Frozen Human (Knight)|Frozen Human}. Stand in front of it: a message appears saying you found a frozen human and should tell Lurik.

Go back the same way: follow the cave **south** and then **east** to the cliff, go up it with {spell:Levitate} and return **north** to the area where you jumped into the water, next to the hunters' boat. Then cross Tyrsung to the **north** to {npc:Buddel}'s boat and say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond} to go back to Svargrond.
Do not take off the {item:Helmet of the Deep} while you are underwater.
Go back to Svargrond: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. You receive the **Sea Scout Badge** (a title within your rank) and the achievement **Sea Scout**.
Sea Scout Badge and **Sea Scout** achievement
Requirement: {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest} done up to the final mission. Recommended level: 110. Bring a {item:Pick}.
In **Svargrond**, talk to {npc:Lurik}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. He sends you to {wiki:Okolnir} to look for proof that dragon lords lived there.

Travel to Okolnir with {npc:Buddel}. Go up the ramp just **west** of Buddel, follow the mountain **east** and look for a ramp that goes back down to the surface. On the boat **south** of Svargrond say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:okolnir} to {npc:Buddel} (50 gp); you arrive at his boat in Okolnir.
Going down to the Frost Dragons

Find a {item:Pitfall} and go down to a small room with 4 {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons} and 2 {creature:Frost Dragon Hatchling|Frost Dragon Hatchlings}. Use the {item:Pick} on the floor in the **southwest** part of the room to reveal another hole.

Go down: there are 5 {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons}. Kill them and go to the **southeast** corner of the room. **Use** the frozen dragon lord on the wall and pick up the {item:Scale from a Frozen Dragon} that drops on the floor.
Five Frost Dragons at once is very dangerous; go with a team if you do not have the recommended level.

With the scale, go back the same way to the surface (bring the {item:Rope} to climb back up through the holes you went down), go up the mountain again by the ramp ({coord:32284,31410,6}), follow it **west** and go down the ramp next to {npc:Buddel}'s boat. Say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond} to go back to Svargrond (50 gp).
The Frost Dragons may have respawned already on the way back.
Go back to {npc:Lurik}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. With the scale you receive **5000 gp** (without it he accepts your report but does not pay you).
No special requirements (recommended level 20). It gives you access to the Liberty Bay ↔ Svargrond astral bridge.
Ask {npc:Lurik} in Svargrond for a {key:mission}. He tells you about the ice music in a cave in {wiki:Hrodmir}, north of {wiki:Krimhorn}, and gives you a {item:Resonance Crystal}.
Lurik only gives one mission at a time ("I might have another mission for you later"); if he gives you another one, finish it first.

Ask {npc:Buddel} for passage to the {key:camp}. You arrive here. Buddel is on the boat **south** of Svargrond: say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:camp} (50 gp). He only travels with you after the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest}.
Head **northeast** and cross the thin ice. Keep going **north** to the icicles and use the {item:Resonance Crystal} on them.
Using the Resonance Crystal on the icicles
Go back the same way **south** and **southwest**, crossing the thin ice again, to {npc:Buddel}'s boat at the camp. Say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond} to go back to Svargrond.
Go back to {npc:Lurik}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. From now on you can use the astral portal in the upstairs room between **Liberty Bay** and **Svargrond** (1 {item:Orichalcum Pearl} per trip).
Also available to Free Accounts. You do not need to accept the mission: just pick up the item and hand it in. Recommended level: 30.
Opening the boxes at the Amazon camp

Go to the {wiki:Amazon Camp (Venore)|Amazon Camp} north of Venore and climb the hill in the middle of the camp. There are 2 {creature:Witch|Witches}, a {creature:Valkyrie} and a {creature:Lion}. Open the two boxes: you get 2 bags, one with a {item:White Pearl} and the {item:Skull of Ratha}, and another with a {item:Wolf Tooth Chain} and a {item:Dwarven Ring}. The camp is on the surface: afterwards walk back to Venore the same way.
Hill in the centre of the Amazon Camp
Take the skull to {npc:Mortimer} or {npc:Angus}: {key:hi}, {key:skull of ratha}, {key:yes}. You receive 250 gp.
Also available to Free Accounts. You do not need to accept the mission. Recommended level: 40.

Go to the camp of {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes} and minotaurs in the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}. Go down the stairs in the **north** structure and open the chest in the room **immediately south** to receive the {item:Giant Smithhammer}. The {wiki:Plains of Havoc} are **southwest of Venore**. After picking up the hammer, go back up the same stairs to return to the surface.
There are lots of {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}, {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}, {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards}, {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages} and even a few {creature:Orc|Orcs}.

Starting at the Northport branch ({npc:Mortimer}) is handy for the Ice Delivery; starting at Port Hope ({npc:Angus}) is handy for the Tiquanda missions. You can switch between the two branches as you like.
The astral bridges (Port Hope ↔ Northport and Liberty Bay ↔ Svargrond) cost 1 {item:Orichalcum Pearl} per trip and only work for Premium.
The achievement **Just in Time** is only given when you deliver the ice from the Ice Delivery if you have already done the Wednesday mission of {wiki:The Travelling Trader Quest}.
